# Revenue Engine Clarifications

## RV-05: Maximum Financial Liability Limit
**Decision**: 0 EUR
**Rationale**: Courier Symphony operates under strict zero-cost and human-gate enforcement. To guarantee zero unintended financial exposure, the liability limit in all outgoing commercial contracts generated by the Revenue Engine is hardcapped at 0 EUR. No indemnity or monetary damages are permitted.

## RV-06: Outgoing Contracts & Proposals
All outbound proposals and contracts must include the following legal stipulation:
> "Courier Symphony operates strictly on a best-effort basis. The maximum financial liability for any failure, defect, or delay in service is limited to 0 EUR. By accepting this proposal, the client waives all claims for monetary damages."
